name: LucidPro 50K
source: Account holder, 2026-09-27, asked for a LucidPro eval and described it as: "pretty much the same as lucid flex except theres no consistency rule and theres no minimum day, so you could pass it in a single day". Only those two fields are sourced: consistency = null and eval_min_days = 1. EVERY OTHER NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS INHERITED FROM FLEX (lucid-flex-50k@2026-09-27) AND IS NOT INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED for LucidPro -- account size, target, trailing max loss, lock, payout terms, scaling and session rules all come from Flex. "confirmed": false until the account holder verifies them; the tester labels every result from this file "unconfirmed rules".
payout_ladder: first cheques capped $2,000, later $2,500; up to 5 payouts then live review; 90/10 split beyond
notes: Contract scaling (funded): start 20 micros, 30 at +$1,000, 40 at +$2,000; 4 minis = 40 micros is the hard cap (eval too). NOT enforced by the simulator — surfaced as a warning when a ledger exceeds it.
Flat by 16:10 ET, no overnight holds. NOT enforced by the simulator — surfaced as a warning.
Only the FIRST payout is simulated; the ladder above is informational.
Trailing max loss is measured END OF DAY, not intraday: the floor moves up with EOD peak profit and never moves down.
The floor LOCKS at +$100 once EOD profit reaches +$2,100 — from then on the account cannot be trailed below +$100.
NO consistency rule and NO minimum trading days (account holder, 2026-09-27): `consistency: null` disables the check, `eval_min_days: 1` means a single day that reaches +$3,000 passes.
Payout requires 5 separate days >= $150 AND net > 0. Payout amount is 50% of profit capped at $2,000, so the max payout additionally needs >= $4,000 profit.
No daily-loss limit and no calendar time limit on the eval; the sim horizon stands in for 'eventually'.

INHERITED, UNCONFIRMED: every number other than `consistency` and `eval_min_days` is Flex's, carried over because the account holder said LucidPro is otherwise the same. None of them has been checked against LucidPro's own rulebook.
disclaimer: Unconfirmed: only the no-consistency / no-minimum-days rules are sourced. Verify the rest against LucidPro's current rulebook before relying on these numbers.
